name: Living For Today
overview: Living for today, according to Scripture, calls believers to trust in God's provision and presence without anxiety, as He promises strength and help in Isaiah 41:10 and instructs not to worry about daily needs in Matthew 6:31. True life is measured not by worldly gain but by the condition of the soul, emphasizing eternal perspective over temporal success (Matthew 16:26). Christians are called to love beyond natural inclinations (Luke 6:32), to serve and support others generously (Acts 20:35), and to reject conformity to worldly values by renewing their minds to discern God’s perfect will (Romans 12:2).
